definitions.full: H5345. neqeb I. [ נֶ֫קֶב ] noun [masculine] technical term of jeweller's work, probably some hole or cavity (Hi-Sm Co Berthol; Toy Hpt leaves untranslated ), — only plural suffix וּנְקָבֶיךָ תֻּמֶּיךָ Ezek 28:13 thy sockets and thy grooves (Da), or thy settings and thy sockets .
